definitions.gloss: cautionary note; warning notice; written warning; instructions
definitions.explanation: A written notice or label that warns about dangers, restrictions, or important information that the reader should be aware of.

examples.japanese: {注意書|ちゅういが}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please read the cautionary notes carefully.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{注意書|ちゅういが}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{副作用|ふくさよう}→副作用：05015_fukusayou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{書|か}いてあった→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The warning notice on the medicine mentioned side effects.

examples.japanese: ⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{注意書|ちゅういが}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{無視|むし}して→無視する：17288_mushisuru⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つながること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Ignoring the product warnings when using it can lead to accidents.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧ (caution/attention) and {書|が}き (writing/notation). Found on product packaging, medicine labels, signs, contracts, and various documents. Common in everyday Japanese life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {注意書|ちゅういが}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read the warning notice
- {注意書|ちゅういが}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧: to follow the instructions/warnings
- {注意書|ちゅういが}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check the cautionary notes
- {注意書|ちゅういが}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{添|そ}える→添える：13315_soeru⟧: to attach a cautionary note

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{警告|けいこく}→警告：02696_keikoku⟧: warning — stronger, more urgent
- ⟦{但|ただ}し{書|が}き→但し書き：15306_tadashigaki⟧: proviso, stipulation — a qualifying clause in a legal or official document
- ⟦{取扱説明書|とりあつかいせつめいしょ}→取扱説明書：10278_toriatsukaisetsumeisho⟧: instruction manual — comprehensive product instructions
